title: GetRowsJsonApiModel
description: JSON API model for get Rows.

data.description: The primary data of the document

meta.description: Non-standard meta information about the document

links.description: Links related to the primary data

columnId.description: The `columnId` identifying which column this cell belongs to.

value.description: The cell's current value. Type must match the column's `dataType`. Provide on create/update; returned on read. This could be of datatypes `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `string array`, `numeric array`, `JsonString(JsonObject, JsonArrayOfObjects)` depending on the column definition

state.description: Processing state of this cell. One of `RESULT`, `BLANK`, `LOADING`, `ERROR`, or `NO_RESULT`. Read-only.

errorDetails.description: Populated only when `state` is `ERROR`. Contains the error reason and whether re-running enrichment is expected to succeed.

CellDetails.description: Defines the data and processing state for a single cell within a row.

summary.description: Short human-readable label for the error.

description.description: Full explanation of the error — what went wrong and why.

retryable.description: Whether re-running enrichment for this cell is expected to succeed. If `false`, the error is permanent until the underlying data issue is resolved.

CellErrorDetails.description: Describes an error that occurred during enrichment for a specific cell.

CellState.description: Processing state of a cell value within a row. Indicates whether enrichment has run and what the outcome was.

x-enumDescriptions.RESULT: A value was successfully retrieved — the cell holds valid data.
x-enumDescriptions.BLANK: No value has been set — the cell is empty and enrichment has not been attempted.
x-enumDescriptions.LOADING: Enrichment is currently in progress for this cell — the value is not yet available.
x-enumDescriptions.ERROR: Enrichment failed for this cell — see `errorDetails` for the reason and whether it is retryable.
x-enumDescriptions.NO_RESULT: Enrichment completed but returned no data — ZoomInfo found no data for this cell.

NumericArrayItem.description: Represents a list of numeric values for a field

page.description: Field representing the current page number

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource

values.description: Array of cell details for this row. Each entry corresponds to one column identified by `columnId`.

RowAttributes.description: Contains all cell data for a row, organized as an array of `CellDetails` objects — one per column.

first.description: A link to the first page of data

last.description: A link to the last page of data

prev.description: A link to the previous page of data

next.description: A link to the next page of data

StringArrayItem.description: Represents a list of string values for a field
